NON-DISCLOSURE AGREEMENT

This Non-Disclosure Agreement is entered into on 8 February 2025 between
Orion Fintech Private Limited, Bengaluru (hereinafter "the Disclosing Party")
and Mr. R. Verma, a software consultant residing at Whitefield, Bengaluru
(hereinafter "the Receiving Party").

1. CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION
Confidential Information means any information disclosed by the Disclosing Party
in any form, whether or not marked as confidential.

2. OBLIGATIONS OF THE RECEIVING PARTY
The Receiving Party shall not disclose any Confidential Information to any third
party and shall use it solely for the purpose of the engagement. The obligations
of confidentiality shall survive the termination of this Agreement in perpetuity.

3. RESTRICTION ON ENGAGEMENT
The Receiving Party shall not, for a period of thirty six months after the
termination of this Agreement, be engaged by or render services to any competing
business in the financial technology sector anywhere in India.

4. LIQUIDATED DAMAGES
In the event of any breach of this Agreement the Receiving Party shall pay to the
Disclosing Party liquidated damages of Rs. 25,00,000 in addition to any other
remedy available.

5. AMENDMENT
The Disclosing Party reserves the right to amend these terms at any time at its
sole discretion by written notice to the Receiving Party.

6. GOVERNING LAW AND JURISDICTION
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of Singapore and the courts at
Singapore shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising hereunder.
